in_arabic.name: عوفية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عوف، يعني العافي والسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عوفية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-و-ف' والذي يعني العافي والكامل في الصحة والسلام. ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وروحانية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية العربية.

in_urdu.name: عوفیہ
in_urdu.meaning: عوف سے مشتق، مطلب ہے صحت مند اور سلیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: عوفیہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-و-ف' سے نکلا ہے، جو کہ صحت مند اور مکمل سلامتی کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاص معانی اور اہمیت رکھتا ہے، اور اکثر اس کا تعلق عوف بن غفار رضی اللہ عنہ سے جواز سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: औफियाह
in_hindi.meaning: अरबी मूल से, अर्थ है स्वस्थ और साला
in_hindi.long_meaning: औफियाह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'औफ' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है स्वस्थ और पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण मानी जाती है और अक्सर इसकी जड़ें इस्लामी इतिहास में पाई जाती हैं।

in_pashto.name: عوفیه
in_pashto.meaning: د عوف څخه مشتق شوی، معنی یې صحت مند او سالم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عوفیه نوم د عربی کلمې 'ع-و-ف' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د صحت مند او بشپړ سالم معنی لري. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې ځانګړی معنا او اهميت لري، او ډیری وختونه د عوف بن غفار رضی الله عنه سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Aufiyyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root, meaning healthy and complete
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aufiyyah originates from the Arabic root 'ع-و-ف', signifying health, completeness, and safety. It holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting positive attributes and often linked to historical figures such as Auf ibn Ghafar. The name symbolizes a state of well-being and peace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aufiyyah holds a significant cultural impact through its meaning as "she who gives happiness, joy, and blessings." This name is reminiscent of the idea of giving and creating joy in the lives of others, which is a cherished value in many Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures. It echoes the importance of charity, kindness, and generosity, emphasizing the importance of creating a joyful and positive atmosphere for those around us. The name Aufiyyah also represents the hope for a life filled with happiness, blessings, and joy, echoing the aspirational and optimistic nature of Islamic and Middle Eastern communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Aufiyyah is deeply rooted in the Islamic belief in the importance of kindness, generosity, and embodying joy and happiness. The name reminds us of the role we play in the spiritual lives of others, as create joy and positivity in the world around us. It also serves as a reminder to strive for happiness, joy, and blessings in our own lives through self-improvement, acts of kindness, and prayer. Additionally, the name Aufiyyah can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic belief in God as the ultimate giver of blessings and joy, emphasizing the importance of staying connected to the divine through daily prayer, worship, and good deeds.
